dropcount.config.title: drop count
dropcount.option.enabled.description: Shows the tags above dropped items. Can also be toggled with the hotkey.
dropcount.option.filter.description: Whitelist: only the listed items get a tag. Blacklist: everything except the listed items gets a tag.
dropcount.option.merge_mode.description: How stacks of a cluster are combined.
dropcount.option.row_length.description: How many items are drawn per row before a new row starts.
dropcount.option.prevent_overlap.descrip: Pushes tags apart when they would overlap each other.
dropcount.option.max_distance.descriptio: Item entities further away than this (in blocks) get no tag.
dropcount.option.scale.description: Multiplier of the tag size, 1 is the size of a vanilla name tag.
dropcount.option.distance_falloff.descri: How fast tags shrink with distance. 1 is the vanilla 1 / distance, 0 keeps every tag the same size.
dropcount.option.shulker_enabled.descrip: Draws an extra tag with the contents of dropped shulker boxes.
